all_integer_Z3_collision_audit.domain: all (z1,z2,z3) in Z^3, all eight reflection branches, both root signs, and all 166x166 ordered nonendpoint seed-facet pairs
all_integer_Z3_collision_audit.method: the three commuting translations satisfy Ki^3=0 and Ki*Kj=0 for i!=j; for every moving branch/source, [K1v,K2v,K3v,u] has rank 4, so quotienting by the common null line gives the unique rational candidate (z1,z2,z3), whose integrality and all 13 coordinates are then checked exactly

bounded_coxiter_corpus_replay.scope_warning: These two pinned CoxIter lanes are not a publication-complete denominator; literal header absence is not worldwide novelty.

endpoint_orbit_audit.endpoint_to_BBB_exclusion: the 12 BBB roots and six endpoint roots are distinct canonical roots; BBB roots are fixed by the whole selected reflection subgroup
endpoint_orbit_audit.endpoint_to_moving_side_exclusion: pairing with the common null vector is zero on endpoints and nonzero on every moving side facet

formula_audit.epsilon_convention: let E=0 if N1,N2,N3 are all even and E=1 otherwise; epsilon=E for even phase-flip parity and epsilon=2-E for odd phase-flip parity

symmetry_orbit_audit.phase_and_parameter_consequence: the two listed triples are conjugate and all six permutations of the three box parameters are lattice-isometric; the certified chamber centralizer realizes exactly the even endpoint-flip subgroup, producing two phase-parity orbits rather than silently identifying all 48 labelled factor/endpoint actions

theorem.Coxeter_reason: the index-Ni reflection subgroup of each commuting D_infinity factor has an Ni-chamber interval; their direct product box is a Coxeter fundamental chamber, and the all-Z3 audit gives its exact exterior-wall identifications

carrier.scope: weak full-Picard divisor-reflection carrier; no full-nef or surface-automorphism assertion

theorem.epsilon_convention: let E=0 if N1,N2,N3 are all even and E=1 otherwise; epsilon=E for even phase-flip parity and epsilon=2-E for odd phase-flip parity
theorem.finite_volume_reason: the box is the union of exactly N1*N2*N3 interiors-disjoint copies of the independently finite-volume seed chamber
theorem.noncompact_reason: the box contains a closed noncompact seed chamber and retains the common ideal direction
theorem.phase_classification: the certified centralizer has two phase-parity orbits; when all Ni are even their facet counts differ by one, proving the two resulting polytopes nonisometric; when some Ni is odd the counts coincide and no wider isometry identification is claimed here
